app.name: Antiskino
app.tagline: Book a camping pitch in Greece in under a minute.

explore.title: Find a camping pitch
explore.body: Search by dates, guests and equipment will appear here.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.body: Campings you save with the heart will appear here.

bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.body: Sign in to see your bookings here.

account.title: Account
account.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't available in this build yet.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a one-time code. No password needed.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.invalidCode: Enter the code from the email.
errors.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.signupDisabled: Sign-in with an email code is turned off.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

signInRequired.title: Sign in to continue
signInRequired.body: This area is for partner campings and the Antiskino team.

denied.title: No access
denied.partner: Your account isn't on a partner camping's team yet. Ask the camping's owner for an invite.
denied.admin: This area is for the Antiskino team.

partner.title: Partner area
partner.body: Today, bookings, availability and rates for your campings will appear here.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.body: Partners, campings, bookings and reviews will appear here.
